items.Sentence: Treatment facilities consist of screening, pre-aeration/grit removal, primary sedimentation, biological filtration (trickling filters), odor control, solids contact stabilization (activated sludge), and secondary clarification. Biosolids (sewage sludge or solid wastes) are treated on the site using gravity thickening, anaerobic digestion, drying beds, and belt filter press dewatering, and are land-applied at various sites. Methane gas by-product from sludge digestion is used as a fuel for producing electrical energy and heat, which are then used at the facility.
Biosolids (sewage sludge or solid wastes) are treated on the site using gravity thickening, anaerobic digestion, drying beds, and belt filter press dewatering, and are land-applied at various sites.
The leachate is hauled to the facility via trucks and is discharged into the septic receiving station and from there is directed into the headworks.
